effects: Converts the pending votes of the signer's account (resolved from the vote signer msg.sender) for `group` into active votes that earn epoch rewards.
No CELO leaves or arrives; the locked CELO stays locked and votes for the same group.
formats.shown: Intent "Activate" with the validator group and the signer as 'Vote signer'.

findings.title: activate intent "Activate" does not say that pending votes for the group become active.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json, activate format: "intent": "Activate". The function activates pending votes of the account for `group` (Celo Election.activate). The word alone does not name votes.
findings.fix: Set intent to "Activate pending votes" and add interpolatedIntent "Activate pending votes for {group}".

findings.title: activate field group uses addressName types ["contract"], but validator groups are usually EOA accounts.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json, activate format, field `group`: "types": ["contract"]. Celo validator groups are accounts registered in Accounts, mostly EOAs or multisigs.
findings.fix: Set types to ["eoa", "contract"] or remove the types restriction.

effects: Converts the pending votes of `account` for `group` into active votes; the signer pays only gas.
No asset of the signer moves; the effect is on the votes of `account`, which can be another party.
formats.shown: Intent "Activate Votes" with the validator group and the account whose votes are activated.

findings.title: activateForAccount field group uses addressName types ["contract"], but validator groups are usually EOAs.

formats.key: revokeActive(address group, uint256 value, address lesser, address greater, uint256 index)
effects: Removes `value` active votes of the signer's account from `group`; the account stops earning rewards on them.
Moves the same amount of locked CELO back to the account's nonvoting locked balance; no CELO leaves the contract.
formats.shown: Intent "Revoke Votes" with the validator group and 'Votes to Revoke' as a raw integer in wei.

findings.title: revokeActive shows the vote amount as a raw 18-decimal integer instead of a CELO amount.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json, revokeActive format, field `value`: "format": "raw". The value is locked CELO in wei, so 1 CELO shows as 1000000000000000000.

findings.title: revokeActive shares the intent "Revoke Votes" with revokePending and revokeAllActive; active is not stated.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json: revokeActive, revokePending and revokeAllActive all have "intent": "Revoke Votes".
findings.fix: Set intent to "Revoke active votes" and add interpolatedIntent "Revoke {value} active votes from {group}".

findings.title: revokeActive field group uses addressName types ["contract"], but validator groups are usually EOAs.

formats.key: revokeAllActive(address group, address lesser, address greater, uint256 index)
effects: Removes all active votes of the signer's account from `group`; the amount comes from storage, not calldata.
Moves that whole amount of locked CELO back to the account's nonvoting locked balance.
formats.shown: Intent "Revoke Votes" with the validator group only; nothing says that all active votes are revoked.

findings.title: revokeAllActive intent "Revoke Votes" does not say that it revokes all active votes for the group.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json, revokeAllActive format: "intent": "Revoke Votes", and the only visible field is `group`. The function revokes the account's whole active vote balance for the group. The intent is the same as revokeActive, which revokes a chosen amount.
findings.fix: Set intent to "Revoke all active votes" and add interpolatedIntent "Revoke all active votes from {group}".

findings.title: revokeAllActive field group uses addressName types ["contract"], but validator groups are usually EOAs.

formats.key: revokePending(address group, uint256 value, address lesser, address greater, uint256 index)
effects: Removes `value` pending (not yet activated) votes of the signer's account from `group`.
Moves the same amount of locked CELO back to the account's nonvoting locked balance.
formats.shown: Intent "Revoke Votes" with 'Votes to Revoke' as a raw integer in wei and the validator group.

findings.title: revokePending shows the vote amount as a raw 18-decimal integer instead of a CELO amount.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json, revokePending format, field `value`: "format": "raw". The value is locked CELO in wei.

findings.title: revokePending intent "Revoke Votes" does not say that it revokes pending votes, not active ones.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json, revokePending format: "intent": "Revoke Votes", the same as revokeActive.
findings.fix: Set intent to "Revoke pending votes" and add interpolatedIntent "Revoke {value} pending votes from {group}".

findings.title: revokePending field group uses addressName types ["contract"], but validator groups are usually EOAs.

formats.key: vote(address group, uint256 value, address lesser, address greater)
effects: Moves `value` of the signer's account's nonvoting locked CELO into pending votes for `group` (LockedGold.decrementNonvotingAccountBalance).
No CELO leaves the LockedGold contract; the votes must be activated later to earn rewards.
formats.shown: Intent "Vote" with the validator group and 'Gold to Vote' as a raw integer in wei.

findings.title: vote shows the locked CELO amount as a raw 18-decimal integer under the old label "Gold".
findings.evidence: descriptor.json, vote format, field `value`: "label": "Gold to Vote", "format": "raw". The value is locked CELO in wei. "Gold" is the old name of CELO.
findings.fix: Set label to "Locked CELO to vote" and use "format": "tokenAmount" with "params": {"token": "0x471EcE3750Da237f93B8E339c536989b8978a438"}.

findings.title: vote intent "Vote" does not say that locked CELO is committed to a validator group.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json, vote format: "intent": "Vote", and there is no interpolatedIntent.
findings.fix: Set intent to "Vote for validator group" and add interpolatedIntent "Vote {value} locked CELO for {group}".

findings.title: vote field group uses addressName types ["contract"], but validator groups are usually EOAs.
